most_similar_to.why: Highest TF-IDF (0.474) — expected and honest. Both are PRODUCER-side operator swaps (exemplar aggregation → polynomial moments) on the frozen N0054 base, driven by the same PoM literature (arXiv:2604.06129). STRUCTURAL DISTINCTION: N0058 applied 2nd-order moments to a 2x2 part-POOLED statistic (4 parts), destroying within-part layout and cross-part covariance, AND cut capacity −42% (2.04M trainable); N0059 applies the paper's FULL sequence-to-sequence PolyMorpher block (token-averaged moment state H + per-token nonlinear gate σ(W_s X)) to ALL 49 tokens at capacity matched to 3.52M (+0.6% of N0054), with residuals kept exactly as Eq.3, and explicitly WITHOUT ParTY part-pooling. Different design point (full-token vs part-pool; matched-capacity vs −42%; residual-kept; no ParTY). Crucially, N0059 is a PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIER CONTROL for H0081, not a duplicate run: it removes exactly the two confounds (capacity cut, part-pool info destruction) that make N0058 non-attributable.

Shares the strongest principle: a strict capacity-kept structural swap, not an add-on. But they swap OPPOSITE ends of the exemplar pathway: N0057 replaced the CONSUMER (condenser cross-attention → cosine matcher, leaving exemplar aggregation untouched, +1.43); N0059 replaces the PRODUCER (exemplar self-attention → PolyMorpher, leaving the load-bearing condenser cross-attention untouched). Complementary falsifier arms of the same attention law (H0081), not duplicates.

Same module scope (ExemplarEncoder) and same interface invariant (single fused prototype consumed by the load-bearing condenser). But N0054 ADDED an extra scale-source summary on top of the intact attention-aggregated token (input-axis enrichment, the one POSITIVE axis); N0059 REPLACES the aggregation operator itself with a matched-capacity non-attention mixer. Add-information vs swap-operator; the exact distinction H0081 draws.

shared_principles: Scope is the exemplar-embedding interface (h3 + bboxes → (B,K,256)), the one lever §5.14 allows; no frozen-backbone, recipe, or optimizer change.
Frozen-regime single-switch hook: `use_*` flag toggles the delta against N0054; everything else byte-identical (use_pom=False restores the exact N0054 attention path).
Preserve a single fused prototype vector as the condenser key (the invariant that survived N0055/N0056), and never touch the load-bearing condenser cross-attention (the N0057 lesson).

Structural replacement over stacking; polynomial-moment aggregation transplanted from the PoM paper onto the exemplar side, mechanism paired with existing GCA/XScale via interfaces only (§5.14, no internal coupling).
Strict pre-registered kill/tie/confirm ladder against parent 19.647 with the standard +1.5 early-stop bar and a second-seed rule for the non-marginal confirm band.
new_contribution: The param-matched, confound-cleared falsifier of H0081: a full-token PoM-PolyMorpher operator swap that (a) keeps all 49 ROI tokens (no part-pool info destruction), (b) matches head capacity to 3.52M / 31.32M total exactly (+0.6%), (c) keeps the Eq.3 residual path, and (d) excludes the ParTY part-pool that confounded N0058. This is the first control that cleanly attributes whether the exemplar producer SELF-ATTENTION itself is load-bearing, or whether N0058's failure was simply its capacity cut + 2x2 pool. It also tests the paper activation deviation (GELU vs clamp(LeakyReLU)) as a documented minor note. Distinct structural axis: it is a producer-swap falsifier-control (vs N0057 consumer-swap and vs N0058 part-pool producer-swap).
